question: What are the two most common first names among the school administrators? Indicate the district to which they administer.

candidates.sql:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT first_name
  FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  GROUP BY first_name
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 2
)
SELECT 
  CASE idx
    WHEN 1 THEN s.AdmFName1
    WHEN 2 THEN s.AdmFName2
    WHEN 3 THEN s.AdmFName3
  END AS first_name,
  s.District AS district
FROM schools s
CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS idx UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) v
WHERE CASE idx
    WHEN 1 THEN s.AdmFName1
    WHEN 2 THEN s.AdmFName2
    WHEN 3 THEN s.AdmFName3
  END IN (SELECT first_name FROM top)
ORDER BY first_name, district;

question: What is the average time in seconds of champion for each year, before year 1975?
evidence: only champion's finished time is represented by 'HH:MM:SS.mmm'; finished the game refers to time is not null; before year 1975 refers to year < 1975;

candidates.sql:
WITH last_races AS (
  SELECT year, max(round) as max_round FROM races WHERE year < 1975 GROUP BY year
), last_race_ids AS (
  SELECT r.year, r.raceId FROM races r JOIN last_races lr ON r.year = lr.year AND r.round = lr.max_round
), champions AS (
  SELECT ds.driverId, lri.year
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN last_race_ids lri ON ds.raceId = lri.raceId
  WHERE ds.position = 1
)
SELECT c.year, avg(
  CASE 
    WHEN r.time LIKE '%:%:%' THEN 
      (CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, INSTR(r.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 +
       CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, INSTR(r.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(r.time, INSTR(r.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
       CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, INSTR(r.time, ':', 1, 2) + 1) AS REAL))

       CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, INSTR(r.time, ':') + 1) AS REAL))
  END
) as avg_seconds
FROM champions c
JOIN races r2 ON r2.year = c.year
JOIN results r ON r.raceId = r2.raceId AND r.driverId = c.driverId
WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.year

question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
evidence: annual average consumption of customer with the lowest consumption in each segment = total consumption per year / the number of customer with lowest consumption in each segment; Difference in annual average = SME's annual average - LAM's annual average; Difference in annual average = LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.

WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_cons ASC) AS rn
  FROM cust_totals
),
segment_agg AS (
  SELECT Segment, SUM(total_cons) AS sum_cons, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
  GROUP BY Segment

SELECT

FROM segment_agg;
